title: Model names got a tune-up
summary:
The text API gained clearer model routes and more ways to use them, while the community directory filled out with new things people built.

The `llama` alias now selects Llama 4 Scout 17B instead of Llama 3.3 70B, `openai-fast` points to GPT-4.1 nano, and `searchgpt` received a routing fix for GPT-4o mini search preview. Model definitions also gained tier and community metadata and provider-model aliases; `openai-roblox` was removed from the text-model list.

The text API added `openai-reasoning` for o3, then added image input alongside text. Visual reasoning can now use the same model listing.

The queue cap for token-authenticated requests rose from 3 to 20 outside the seed tier. Seed remains capped at 3, and Nectar bypasses the queue only when token-authenticated.

Five community projects joined the lists: DynaSpark for Python-based text, image, and audio generation; StoryBolt for illustrated stories; Coloring AI for sketches and coloring pages; Time Travel Selfie Portal for historical portraits and biographies; and JSON Pollinations API, a Deno Deploy wrapper for JSON responses.
